name: Costa Rica (impuesto al salario, impuesto sobre las utilidades de personas físicas, rentas de capital; CCSS)
kernel_parts_used: Schedule (monthly salary scale, annual profits scale)
headline: Costa Rica 2025 built from Ley 7092 and Decreto 44772-H (SINALEVI): schedular salary/profits/capital taxes with the aguinaldo exemption, CCSS 10,67 %; employees are exempt up to 11,06 M CRC a year against 4,09 M for the self-employed; art. 35 still cites repealed subsections.
